title: 第164章 狗狗祟祟第163章 我一定会是你的女儿
content_zh:
白月躺在床上，看着自己的手，昨日云风和母亲的回答，都是一致的，她并没有学过钢琴，只是曾经被父亲教过学古琴。
从他们的话语中，可以推断出，如果她真的是父母的女儿，真的是孔家的孩子……
那么总结起来，她在前世，本来应是孔家名正言顺的大小姐，却大约3岁左右就已经失踪，后面不知道经历了什么才认识了云风，相依为命，她还因为不知名的原因被训练到很能打，而且是没学过古武的那种能打，随后还被一群很有势力的人追杀，然后回到1997年。
而且，白月发现了一个问题，那些射箭、搏击、持枪的动作，都是她的肌肉记忆，她根本不需要思考就能做出来，而且她也没有这方面的基础知识，完全靠本能，说明她前世做这些东西做得非常多，身体的肌肉记忆都已经记下来了。
但关于弹钢琴的那一段，白月反而脑海中浮现出非常多的理论知识，脑海中是有目的性地指导她去做那件事，但实际她那天弹钢琴时，指法非常的僵硬、不连贯，没有那种很有手感的感觉。
这其中就能看出区别，一个是大脑会，但手不会。一个是大脑还没反应，手就已经做完了。
如果她真的会弹钢琴，为什么云风和孔夜莺的回答一致的否定？为什么手根本不听大脑的使唤？这很奇怪。像是两套系统，分别来自两个不同的人，被装在同一个身体里。
白月不知道这个想法是怎么冒出来的，想到这一点的时候，她心里有一种很奇怪的感觉，像是有什么东西在远处晃了一下。
她从床上坐起来，摇了摇头，想不通的事，今天想不通就别想了，因为明天也不一定想得通。
今天是给义老交作业的日子了，白月把图纸收拾好，背上包就往学校去。
白月去到办公室时，义老正坐在窗边翻一本泛黄的古书，老花镜架在鼻梁上，摇椅摇得嘎吱响。
白月进门的时候他没有抬头，也不看她，就顾着看书。
她趁机仔细观察这个老头，想起孔夜莺说他是祖宗级别的人物，就觉得这个世界真是玄幻。
“看什么？第二关解出来了没有？”义老发现这小丫头片子歪头歪脑的看着自己，也不知道在看什么。
“嘿嘿，解出来啦。”白月从书包中掏出图纸，递给义老，上面是她的解密过程，还有最终得出的那个坐标。
义老拿下老花镜，眯着眼睛看了一眼，就把图纸丢一边了，“嗯，你解出来了就自己去吧，现在就去。”
“啊？现在？这么突然？”白月都还有些没反应过来。
“别给我磨磨唧唧的，叫你现在去就去，快点儿！现在正是最好的时辰！”义老暴脾气也是上来了，吹胡子瞪眼的。
“好好好，我现在立刻去。”看在老人家的面子上，白月连连答应。
出门口她便拨通了布朗的电话，要求他载自己去一趟孔家。

挂断电话不到十分钟，布朗的车就到了，白月上车时看到布朗一副欲言又止的模样，等驶出去好几公里了，布朗才问道：“小小姐，确认好我们就是去那个位置了吗？”
“对！今天，必须要去那里找到这个位置。”白月举起手上纸条写的一个坐标，斩钉截铁的点点头。
孔家在京城东北角，占地极大，布朗开车从主路拐进去后，还要穿过两条安静的小路，两侧是高高的灰墙，墙头上爬着老藤，墙上的砖有些老旧，看着都很有年头。
白月透过车窗看着那些墙，她上一次来的时候是老爷子召唤，她是被直接带进去的，走的是正门，几乎没看清外围的样子。
这次从侧面绕过来，她才真正感觉到孔家大宅的规模。那些外围的墙面延伸得极远，好像一路都没有断过。
门口第一道岗站着两个门卫，穿着灰色的制服，没有佩戴任何标识，但白月注意到他们站的位置刚好卡在门的两侧，两人之间的距离和角度都很耐人寻味，如果有人想从中间冲过去，正好会被两个人同时拦住。
他们的视线在车进来的时候就已经锁定住，没有移开过。
布朗摇下车窗，跟门卫说了几句话，白月没听懂他们说的是什么，可能是某种交接口号吧？
不一会儿，其中一个门卫看了她一眼，然后点了点头，他们才被放行。
“小姐，我们走偏门。”布朗转头跟白月解释，声音压得很低，“正门进出都要登记，留了记录不好解释。”
他们缓缓开车绕道了侧门，侧门的规格比正门小很多，停好车后，他们才来到一座小建筑前。
布朗从口袋里掏出一把老式的铜钥匙，插进锁孔的时候停顿了一下，像是确认了一下方向，然后才转动。锁芯发出一声沉闷的响动，门开了。
进去之后是一条长长的甬道，两侧是庭院式的花园，种着竹子和一些白月叫不上名字的树木，枝叶从墙头探出来，在地面上投下细碎的阴影。
布朗走在前面，白月跟在后面半步的位置，两个人的脚步声在甬道里被墙壁折返，形成一种轻微的叠响。
布朗没有带她走向正堂，他拐了一个弯，带着白月沿着一条更窄的廊道往左边走，一路上都看不到一个人。
“这边很少有人来。”布朗的声音很轻，到处张望着，显得狗狗祟祟的。“前面是祠堂和旧花园，平日里只有打扫的人才会经过。”
廊道尽头是一个圆形的拱门，门洞上方刻着两个字，字迹已经有些模糊了，白月辨认了一下，才看出是“静园”两个字。
穿过拱门之后，她看到了一座祠堂，屋檐下悬挂着一块用楷书写就的木匾，上书“孔氏宗祠”。
祠堂的门是敞开的，里面光线很暗，隐约能看到一排排的牌位和香炉。
“就是前面那个位置。”布朗停下来，低声说道，好像怕惊动到什么人，“你图纸上的坐标，应该就在祠堂和那片旧花园附近。”

白月正要往前走，身后忽然传来一道声音，把她和布朗两个人都吓得一激灵。
“你们要去哪？”

content_en:
Bai Yue lay on the bed and looked at her hands. Yesterday, Yunfeng and her mother's answers were the same. She had never learned the piano, but was taught the guqin by her father.
From their words, it can be inferred that if she is really the daughter of her parents, a child of the Kong family...
So to sum up, in her previous life, she was supposed to be the legitimate eldest daughter of the Kong family, but she disappeared when she was about 3 years old. She met Yunfeng and lived together for unknown reasons. She was also trained to be very good at fighting for unknown reasons, and she was able to fight without learning ancient martial arts. Later, she was hunted down by a group of very powerful people, and then returned to 1997.
Moreover, Bai Yue discovered a problem. Those archery, fighting, and gun-holding movements were all her muscle memory. She could do them without thinking at all. Moreover, she had no basic knowledge in this area and relied entirely on instinct. This meant that she had done these things a lot in her previous life and her body's muscle memory had been memorized.
But regarding the part about playing the piano, Bai Yue had a lot of theoretical knowledge in her mind, and her mind guided her to do that purposefully. But in fact, when she played the piano that day, her fingering was very stiff and incoherent, and she didn't have that sense of touch.
You can see the difference here. One is that the brain can do it, but the hands can't. One is that the hand has already finished the task before the brain can react.
If she really knew how to play the piano, why did Yunfeng and Kong Yeying give unanimous negative answers? Why don’t the hands listen to the brain at all? This is very strange. It's like two systems, from two different people, installed in the same body.
Bai Yue didn't know how this idea came to her. When she thought of this, she felt a strange feeling in her heart, as if something was shaking in the distance.
She sat up from the bed and shook her head. If you can't figure it out today, don't think about it, because you may not be able to figure it out tomorrow.
Today is the day to hand in homework for Yi Lao. Bai Yue packed up the drawings, put on her bag and went to school.
When Bai Yue went to the office, Yi Lao was sitting by the window reading a yellowed ancient book, with reading glasses on the bridge of his nose and a rocking chair making a creaking sound.
When Bai Yue came in, he didn't raise his head or look at her, just reading.
She took the opportunity to observe the old man carefully, and remembered that Kong Yeying said that he was an ancestor-level figure, and felt that this world was really fantasy.
"What are you looking at? Have you solved the second level?" Yi Lao noticed that the little girl was looking at him crookedly, not knowing what she was looking at.
"Hey, I figured it out." Bai Yue took out the blueprint from her schoolbag and handed it to Yi Lao. On it was her decryption process and the final coordinates.
Yi Lao took off his reading glasses, squinted his eyes and threw the drawing aside, "Well, you can go on your own after you figure it out. Go now."
"Ah? Now? So sudden?" Bai Yue still didn't react.
"Don't keep nagging me. I told you to go now. Hurry up! Now is the best time!" Yi Lao's temper also increased, blowing his beard and glaring.
"Okay, okay, I'll go right now." For the sake of the old man, Bai Yue agreed repeatedly.
When she left the door, she dialed Brown's phone and asked him to drive her to Kong's house.
Less than ten minutes after hanging up the phone, Brown's car arrived. When Bai Yue got in the car, she saw that Brown was hesitant to speak. After driving several kilometers, Brown asked, "Miss, are you sure we are going to that location?"
"Yes! Today, we must go there to find this location." Bai Yue raised the coordinates written on the note in her hand and nodded decisively.
The Kong family occupies a large area in the northeast corner of Beijing. After Brown drove in from the main road, he had to pass through two quiet lanes, flanked by high gray walls.There are old vines climbing on the walls, and the bricks on the walls are a bit old, and they look very old.
Bai Yue looked at the walls through the car window. The last time she came here, the old man summoned her. She was taken directly in and walked through the main entrance, barely seeing the outside.
This time, when she walked around from the side, she really felt the scale of the Kong family mansion. The outer walls extend very far, as if they are not broken all the way.
There were two guards standing at the first post at the door, wearing gray uniforms and without any identification, but Bai Yue noticed that they were standing on both sides of the door. The distance and angle between the two were very intriguing. If someone wanted to rush through the middle, they would be stopped by two people at the same time.
Their eyes had been locked when the car came in, and they never moved away.
Brown rolled down the window and said a few words to the doorman. Bai Yue didn't understand what they said. Maybe it was some kind of exchange signal?
After a while, one of the guards glanced at her and nodded, and they were let out.
"Miss, we took a side door." Brown turned to explain to Bai Yue, his voice was very low, "You have to register when entering and leaving the main entrance. It's hard to explain if you leave a record."
They drove slowly around the side door, which was much smaller than the main entrance. After parking the car, they came to a small building.
Brown took out an old-fashioned copper key from his pocket and paused when inserting it into the keyhole, as if to confirm the direction, and then turned it. The lock cylinder made a dull sound and the door opened.
After entering, there is a long corridor, with courtyard-style gardens on both sides, planted with bamboos and some trees that Bai Yue can't name. The branches and leaves poke out from the wall, casting fine shadows on the ground.
Brown walked in front, and Bai Yue followed half a step behind. The footsteps of the two people were reflected by the wall in the corridor, forming a slight echo.
Brown did not lead her to the main hall. He turned a corner and led Bai Yue to the left along a narrower corridor. He could not see anyone along the way.
"Very few people come here." Brown's voice was very soft, and he looked around like a dog. "In front is the ancestral hall and the old garden. On weekdays, only people cleaning will pass by."
At the end of the corridor is a circular arch. There are two words engraved above the door. The writing is a little blurry. Bai Yue recognized it and saw that it was "Jingyuan".
After passing through the arch, she saw an ancestral hall, with a wooden plaque written in regular script hanging under the eaves, which read "Ancestral Hall of the Kong Family".
The door of the ancestral hall is open, and the light inside is very dark. Rows of tablets and incense burners can be vaguely seen.
"It's the location in front." Brown stopped and whispered, as if he was afraid of disturbing anyone, "The coordinates on your drawing should be near the ancestral hall and the old garden."
Bai Yue was about to walk forward when a voice suddenly came from behind, frightening both her and Brown.
"Where are you going?"
